'''Niro 11''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Niro (planet)|Niro]]. It was owned by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It then fell into the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Clive Flax]] and [[Astri Oddo]] visited this moon when searching for information about [[Eve Yarrow]].

[[Bank Niro Eleven]] was located on the moon.
